product_overview: Reservas Hotel Aurora es una aplicación web para que un huésped consulte habitaciones disponibles, haga una reserva y complete el pago en el sandbox de PayU Latam. También permite ver el estado de las reservas y consultar un listado para recepción.
core_goals: Explorar el catálogo de habitaciones disponibles
Completar una reserva con fechas y datos del huésped
Revisar el resumen de precio antes de pagar
Pagar una reserva mediante PayU sandbox
Ver el resultado y estado final del pago
Consultar la lista de reservas existentes

features.name: Catálogo de habitaciones
features.description: Permite ver las habitaciones disponibles del hotel con su información básica y acceder al flujo de reserva de cada una.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See three room cards with name, description, capacity and nightly rate -> Choose a room to reserve -> Open /reservar/estandar
Navigate to / -> See three room cards with name, description, capacity and nightly rate -> Choose a room to reserve -> Open /reservar/superior
Navigate to / -> See three room cards with name, description, capacity and nightly rate -> Choose a room to reserve -> Open /reservar/suite-aurora

features.name: Formulario de reserva con validación
features.description: Recoge los datos de la estadía y del huésped, calcula noches y total, y valida la información antes de continuar al pago.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservar/estandar -> Fill check-in date -> Fill check-out date -> Fill full name -> Fill email -> Fill mobile number -> Fill guest count -> See nights and total update -> Continue to payment -> See the payment page

Navigate to /reservar/superior -> Fill check-in date -> Fill check-out date -> Fill full name -> Fill email -> Fill mobile number -> Fill guest count -> See field-level validation errors for invalid dates, email, mobile number or guest count

Navigate to /reservar/suite-aurora -> Fill a check-in date in the past -> Fill check-out date -> Fill full name -> Fill email -> Fill mobile number -> Fill guest count -> Click continue to payment -> See an error for the invalid check-in date

Navigate to /reservar/estandar -> Fill a check-out date earlier than the check-in date -> Fill full name -> Fill email -> Fill mobile number -> Fill guest count -> Click continue to payment -> See an error for the invalid date range

features.name: Pago con PayU sandbox
features.description: Muestra el resumen de la reserva y envía los datos necesarios al WebCheckout de PayU en modo sandbox, incluyendo la firma generada en el servidor.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservas/<id>/pago -> See the reservation summary with reference, room, nights and total -> Start payment with PayU -> Open the PayU sandbox checkout page
Navigate to /reservas/<id>/pago -> See the sandbox help box with test card data -> Start payment with PayU -> Enter the approved sandbox card details -> Submit the payment -> Return to the hotel site
Navigate to /reservas/<id>/pago -> See the sandbox help box with test card data -> Start payment with PayU -> Enter the rejected sandbox card details -> Submit the payment -> Return to the hotel site

features.name: Resultado del pago
features.description: Muestra el estado de la reserva después del retorno desde PayU y permite actualizar el estado o reintentar si el pago fue rechazado.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservas/<id>/resultado -> See the reservation status badge, reference, room, dates, total and transaction id
Navigate to /reservas/<id>/resultado -> Return from PayU with valid payment parameters -> See the reservation status update to confirmed or rejected based on the payment result
Navigate to /reservas/<id>/resultado -> See a rejected payment -> Try again -> Receive a new reference -> Open the payment page again
Navigate to /reservas/<id>/resultado -> Return while PayU still reports a pending payment -> Update status -> See the latest stored status refresh

features.name: Lista de reservas
features.description: Permite consultar todas las reservas creadas, ordenadas por fecha, con sus detalles principales y acceso a cada resultado.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservas -> See a table of reservations ordered from newest to oldest -> Open a reservation row -> See that reservation's result page
Navigate to /reservas -> See the message indicating there are no reservations when the list is empty

features.name: Páginas de error no encontradas
features.description: Presenta una página personalizada cuando una reserva o ruta no existe, con salida hacia el catálogo.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservas/does-not-exist/resultado -> See the not found message -> Return to the catalog

routes.description: Room catalog with the three rooms (Estándar, Superior, Suite Aurora) and a "Reservar" link each
Booking form for one room (slugs estandar, superior, suite-aurora) with live price summary
Payment page with the reservation summary, the signed PayU form and a sandbox test-data help box
Payment result; verifies the PayU response signature, queries PayU and shows the reservation status
Reservations list ordered by creation date, newest first

features.name: Room catalog
features.description: Lists the three seeded rooms with name, description, capacity and nightly rate formatted as "$180.000 COP por noche"
user_interactions: Click "Reservar" on a card to open /reservar/<slug>

features.name: Booking form with validation
features.description: Collects check-in, check-out, full name, email, Colombian mobile and number of guests; validates on client and server (check-in today or later in America/Bogota, check-out after check-in, at most 30 nights, name 3 to 80 characters, valid email, 10-digit mobile starting with 3, guests between 1 and room capacity) and shows each error next to its field
user_interactions: See nights and total (data-testid="total") update when the dates change
See per-field error messages for invalid input
See an alert when the room already has a confirmed reservation overlapping the dates (HTTP 409)

features.name: Payment with PayU sandbox
features.description: Shows the reservation summary and a POST form to the PayU sandbox WebCheckout with hidden fields and a server-side MD5 signature; includes a help box with the sandbox test card data
user_interactions: See reference, room, nights and total
Click "Pagar con PayU" (data-testid="pagar-payu") to go to sandbox.checkout.payulatam.com

On PayU: choose Visa, card 4111 1111 1111 1111, year 2027; to approve use name APPROVED, CVV 777 and month 5; to reject use name REJECTED, CVV 666 and month 7; document type C.C., any document number, mobile 3001234567, accept terms, click Pagar, then click Regresar al sitio de la tienda

features.name: Payment result
features.description: When PayU returns with its query parameters, verifies the signature, queries PayU's reports API and updates the status (APPROVED to CONFIRMADA; DECLINED, ERROR, EXPIRED to PAGO_RECHAZADO; PENDING keeps it); never changes the status from the URL alone; without PayU parameters it only shows the stored status
user_interactions: See status badge (data-testid="estado-reserva"), reference, room, dates, total and transaction id
See an error message when the URL carries an invalid PayU signature
Click "Intentar de nuevo" after a rejected payment to get a new reference and return to the payment page
Click "Actualizar estado" while PayU still reports the payment as pending

features.name: Reservations list
features.description: Table of reservations with reference, room, dates, guest, total and status badge, each linking to its result page; shows "Todavía no hay reservas" when empty
user_interactions: See rows with data-testid="fila-reserva" and status badges with data-testid="estado-reserva"
Click a row link to open its result page

features.name: Not found pages
features.description: Custom 404 page for unknown reservations and routes
user_interactions: See the "no encontrada" message and a link back to the catalog

known_limitations.issue: The PayU checkout is a third-party sandbox page; its markup and versions change and it can be slow to answer
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end payment tests depend on an external service outside the application

known_limitations.issue: Locally, PayU cannot reach the confirmation URL (POST /api/webhooks/payu); status changes come from the result page querying PayU
known_limitations.impact: Webhook behaviour is only exercised by simulated requests or on the deployed app

known_limitations.issue: Not-found pages are streamed after the response starts, so the HTTP status is 200 even though the 404 page is shown
known_limitations.impact: Clients that check only the status code see 200 for unknown reservations
